# ghost/calculator

Fossify Calculator: evaluate arithmetic, read the display and history, convert units. No account, no network.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/calculator
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/calculator calculate --device <serial> --param expression=<expression>
ghost skill run ghost/calculator read_result --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/calculator get_history --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/calculator convert_units --device <serial> --param category=<category> --param value=<value> --param from_unit=<from_unit> --param to_unit=<to_unit>
```

## Actions

- `calculate`: Calculate 1234 times 5
- `read_result`: What does the calculator show right now?
- `get_history`: Show my recent calculations
- `convert_units`: Convert 100 Fahrenheit to Celsius
